findings.quote: A replay run reads that reference to rebuild the batch, and the incident review has no other source for the original bytes.
A truncated upload otherwise reaches the loader as a complete batch, and the reconciliation report shows no gap for that hour.
A stage that logs only its errors teaches its operator to read nothing at all.
A field added for one release is a field somebody parses for a decade.
The settling pond holds a normalized row until every dimension key resolves.
The weir admits at most 5,000 rows per second per tenant into the dimension lookup.
